hash_48a48242f5b6e70b: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Alright, the train's slowing down. Let's go to work.
hash_582be45518eafd4c: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Careful, East German guards still patrol these abandoned stations.

hash_2fe3a8c1c01a3706: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Good. You finish up. I'm going back to warm up.

hash_26ecf9b6857fdb0: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Once you're finished there, move to the northern platforms.
hash_2ab772fac8febb71: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^All right. Keep searching. Once we're done here, we're moving to the northern platforms.

hash_35398ed06e86b61c: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Come on. This is the way out.
hash_b9469b2a8d23410: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Good. I need to sit down. My feet are killing me.
hash_35164d0ef4abdc57: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Hey, Karl, why do the Stasi work together in groups of three?
hash_f097c93addd4b18: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^When are we supposed to go on patrol again?
hash_2d81b4f664ab5418: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You need one who can read, one who can write, and a third to keep an eye on the two intellectuals.
hash_8f6f5d63c395cb9: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I don't know. Why do the Stasi work together in groups of three?
hash_160f67a96b4de243: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^What are you complaining about? You've only been on duty for two hours. I've been here for eight.
hash_70c3cb12680afce0: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I work for the railroad. Let me show you my ID.
hash_24ffa0fa3783606c: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Wait, wait, wait. Just calm down. I'm sure we can figure something out. Let's ...
hash_70dd841045ee7b0d: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^That area is off limits. You're under arrest, get down on the ground!
hash_dba7b5d00baf03e: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We will shoot you if you don't listen. Get down now!

hash_74ff6c0145c772f5: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^They know how to lock a place down, I'll give 'em that.
hash_780b0f6e1d06fa0c: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Damn ... security's even tighter than usual. If they detain Kraus, he could miss his meeting with Volkov.
hash_770eb826656f98bc: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Find Kraus before he gets past us.
hash_29c033bde016676: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Good job. That's our man - that's Kraus.
hash_3e8b3a54e72a8e08: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Keep an eye on that checkpoint. Kraus will be coming through any time.
hash_21ca5731b5a5c188: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Near the checkpoint; man with the briefcase. Is that him?
hash_4f81a0f454bbab39: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I'll stay out here and watch the street.

hash_778abade12a9ec0a: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Our intel says Kraus and Volkov will meet at the bar across the street.
hash_7997b20c850023a2: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Park, Kraus just crossed the Wall. What's your status?
hash_f760999fdd19630: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Park: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Lazar and I are at the exfil point awaiting your arrival.
hash_87dc8107426c541: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I'm on my way to work. I'm running late.
hash_16fedabab22f0cc3: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Please, my boss is going to fire me. Can you let me go?
hash_53b890fe1f2cbcba: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It's my job to question all suspicious individuals.
hash_75d001f9bb7e7d48: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Now you're going to be even later, my friend.
hash_229d799402733b0d: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Where were you going in such a hurry?
hash_66611666c0f4e51: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^That's what I said. I grabbed the wrong coat at the bar. I don't know where that money came from.
hash_5451c01f20feb4db: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^No, the bar was crowded. It could be anyone's.
hash_5669d1fbd2780b3c: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Do you know whose coat it is?
hash_d5f69d01a386472: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Which is why I will ask you again; what are you doing with American money?
hash_6b095015ea6d49b7: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Who would leave a thousand US dollars unattended in a coat pocket?

hash_35f885c98e932eac: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Just leftovers from lunch. A friend and I were at the lake today.
hash_36e194d201cea07: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We drove separately. Why are you stopping me?
hash_41bddfa74095cc85: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^So. Anything interesting in the trunk?
hash_3f3a11995a877afa: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Criminal activity here earlier. Could be more.
hash_36f5d086441a7692: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^No. We took a train to Passow. I left the car with my brother.
hash_5469820881e352eb: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^That's impossible. I was out of town last week.
hash_3025cbdba0279a24: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Why? My brother would never do anything wrong.
hash_455754a6f6969670: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Yes, my wife and two sons. They were with me.
hash_f1cc0491f7906b2: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Do you know anyone who can confirm this?
hash_4c3cce553fc5f36: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Then I need to know his address.

hash_5efadeaad667ec5b: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^No, sir. I've never been in any kind of trouble with the law.
hash_2fd24da909d5c339: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^That's because I've never been questioned like this before. My papers are in order, aren't they?
hash_1a3d4a0b69341cd0: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You don't need to do that. It would be a waste of your time.
hash_2f32bfc965e2c840: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^So if I were to take you in for questioning, we wouldn't have any record on file for you?
hash_3bdd424836030d2d: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Would it? You seem very nervous.
hash_6a369d6c1dbca348: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Yes, your papers are in order. But you look familiar. Have we met before?
hash_25e547af74decdc8: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I know him from work. But I don't think you would call us friends.
hash_de80bb6235ef6bc: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You can't be serious. For what?

hash_69049b09044fb0e5: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Are you a friend of a Mr. Gerhard Weber?
hash_3f89aef79f395fa5: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^He gave us your name while being questioned.
hash_7e0184297c1e81da: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^That may be, Mr. Fischer, but there is a warrant out for your arrest.
hash_1ab7dea2494a0c1f: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^That's ridiculous. Hans is a model citizen!
hash_7edb97c63dcfa756: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Crimes? Hans? Hans drives a milk truck.
hash_2d89bd63ab927fda: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Two nights ago. We invited him over for supper.
hash_55cac7bc719de6d0: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^And are you aware of his crimes?
hash_1a6d76430df3a2ec: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Your cousin apparently moves more than milk across the wall. You're not aware of the defectors?
hash_109042e5c264016: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^When did you last see your cousin?
hash_77a605f57bc88d17: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^He was heavy set and had a tattoo of a skull on the back of his right hand.
hash_3aeb7847a1123f9a: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Yes, he was driving a laundry truck. The back door popped open when he had to stop quickly. I only saw it for a second, but I thought I saw weapons in the back.
hash_72c3da933b86fd84: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^And you believe he was smuggling guns into the city?
hash_522e19a97372e629: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Had you ever seen the man before?
hash_727014d6040f133c: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Anything else you can tell us?
hash_52eddcf3b5a7c6e1: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Bell, The Contact's waiting for you at the bar.
hash_1a55ad6b6a956b51: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Bell, The Contact's waiting for you at the bar.
hash_4f0a964169abacba: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Get to the meeting at the bar.
hash_260331848097d92a: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Get to the meeting at the bar.
hash_7901077bde9a42f2: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Go to the bar and meet the Contact, Bell.
hash_185c836df52dc172: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Go to the bar and meet the Contact, Bell.
hash_693d6e8b1b4e5449: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^What, you just left her alone in the cinema? How did she get home?
hash_8bed52fa5ef9c59: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Yes, definitely. I'll take her number. She can apparently do better.

hash_6d6fbcef2cd63a8d: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^There is no "after the movie" part.
hash_1eff4340c1224ad2: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^It was fine. Just dinner and a movie.
hash_73dc40bd7f56b2f2: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You guys don't need to worry about how Sabine got home.
hash_650f3646b2673eda: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Be sure to give me a full report on how that goes.
hash_1d1015586a6cef2: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^And no redactions like Martin over here.
hash_5396a0bd955fccf6: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I'm very worried about it actually.
hash_43e02ed605ddcee4: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Seriously? Of course she would. We could use the money.
hash_376e05dd24464b94: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^The kids are doing great. And Erika just got a job as a bookkeeper for a doctor.
hash_79e5f9650b551c49: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Congratulations. Erika's a smart one. She'll do a great job. Any chance she'd want to do my books?
hash_6bef94da8f16c812: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Great. Have her stop by tomorrow.
hash_7ae893abe573c0e8: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Hello, Karl. What can I get you?

hash_273ea52c074ecf90: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Female: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I think you're going to like this a lot.
hash_edf4b39cfe831f8: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Female: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Not right now. But check back with us in a bit.
hash_67cac6665275ccab: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Female: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Thank you. I'm sure we will.

hash_4a54e9e18d2fe0c7: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Female: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Good evening, sir. What can I get you?
hash_159fd95ec65db4f4: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Greta: ^7^Fmaxima_med^My friend! I'm so happy you made it!
hash_7ccea0a444b83d22: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Greta: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Kraus is at the table over my right shoulder.
hash_12f99ae87c17c648: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Team, new plan. Meet outside Kraus's apartment. He's still our ticket to Volkov.
hash_5f933c442da9f81b: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Bell, we've got trouble. There's two Stasi entering the bar.
hash_64bbbbc433d22607: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Heads up, Bell. I think Volkov is walking in.
hash_390a9b71f8e727a6: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You were followed. Go home and wait for our call. There will be a new time and place. We'll take care of the tail.
hash_2990d95cb940f825: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Greta: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Hudson didn't reveal much - he said you're after Volkov?

hash_a46394fb50e4536: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Greta: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Kraus is ex-Stasi so don't let his wholesome appearance fool you; the man is a killer.
hash_17cb8e2c16efbaa: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Greta: ^7^Fmaxima_med^One of my informants was picked up in a random sweep, just two blocks from here. The Stasi must assume there are more nearby.
hash_5ab4fff5e7aabccd: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Greta: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Scheisse.... Go through the bathroom, I'll hold them off.
hash_3189a446fdcff988: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Greta: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Who knows? The man's like a ghost. I would guess no more than a day.
hash_74c9ad7290de316e: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Do you hear me? Open the door!
hash_4881e77d935c8742: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I order you to come out here!
hash_551e68402ba34e4a: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Open up. This is the Stasi.
hash_2f123615e8b147a9: ^8^Fmaxima_bol^Adler: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Rally up with Lazar and Park without me. I'll update you when I can.
hash_1fbac10cccae5c16: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I am staying with my friend tonight. We had a few drinks at the bar.
hash_70420b8185766617: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Fine, fine, but you can see my place from here!
hash_299d98a09f8673fc: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^My building is right through the square. We were just heading back.
hash_3dea5752ff2c9116: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^I was just passing by. Is that against the law?
hash_4c06506611459c05: ^<^Fmaxima_bol^German Male: ^7^Fmaxima_med^You didn't find anything on me - what would I have been doing?
hash_10e2dd260d331360: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^Either you're up to something or you are completely unaware of your situation.
hash_637bbe2faa814afc: ^9^Fmaxima_bol^GDR Soldier: ^7^Fmaxima_med^We can always tell, eh Becker?

You are engaged in one of the most demanding video battles ever conceived.

hash_5c9073d0094cf5df:

Before you can begin the route, touch down the Rocket Module with precision. Push forward to thrust, pull back to cut engines.

^L^;The Astrobus follows the movements of the Joystick.  To blast meteors and space mines, press [{^BBUTTON_SELECTCHOICE^;+gostand}]. 

To pick up a  commuter, fly over their head and quickly pull the Joystick towards you^7.
hash_13192fb1e0d551da:
A bug barrage is swarming out of the sewer, chomping away at every building in town. Potsy, the rooftop gardener, is defending his beloved building with his only weapon - potted petunias. 

Help him take potshots at the insect invaders... Quick! When too many bugs crawl into the windows, they'll start eating you out of house and home!

^L^;Move behind a pot and press [{^BBUTTON_SELECTCHOICE^;+gostand}] to push it over the ledge.

Play for the high score and the game ends when the creepy crawlers have gobbled up six layers of the building^7.
hash_6feb9c11cf34b9a4:
Marooned on the ice planet Krybor, you watch legions of eerie creatures scream overhead. They hover ominously. They give you no quarter. Attack and destroy them, or be destroyed! Armed with your Laser Cannon, you confront the ultimate challenge: SURVIVE!

^;Press [{^BBUTTON_SELECTCHOICE^;+gostand}] to fire your laser cannon. Dodge left or right to avoid enemy fire while pursuing aliens. Accumulate Reserve Bunkers (bottom left of screen). You begin with 3. Each attack wave you survive completely unscathed earns you an additional bunker, to a maximum of 6. Every hit you absorb destroys an additional bunker. When all bunkers disappear, another alien barrage will vaporize you.^7

Games 1,3,5 and 7 pit you against progressively more difficult waves of alien adversaries. Pick up the pace: the higher the game number, the greater the challenge!  Games 3 and 7 feature special tracer shots. Your Laser Cannon powers fire all over the screen.
hash_59815ec282d28579:
You never fear, never sleep. There is no finish line. Your only goal in life is to break your own last record.

The race is set. Are you?

^L^;The number of cars you must pass is posted in the lower right corner of the screen. When you pass the required number of cars, green flags will appear. After that, any additional miles will be added to your total.

Pass the number of required cars by daybreak to move on to the next day!^L^7
hash_1cf121c4765e8ff5:
The most beautiful picture you've ever seen in a video game! Two fishermen drop their lines into a bay full of sunfish.  But watch out for that shark!

^L^;Keep pulling in those fish, because the first player to catch their 99 pound limit is the winner! Go deep for the big fish (heavy) or play it safe with the small fry (light) near the surface.

Press [{^BBUTTON_SELECTCHOICE^;+gostand}] to quickly reel in your fish once you have one hooked. Only one fisherman can quickly reel at a time though!^L^7
hash_16cbba1a7c5322c4:

^L^;Press [{^BBUTTON_LUI_ALT2^;+smoke}] to select your game: Watkins Glen (1), Brands Hutch (2), Le Mans (3), or Monaco (4).

Complete a race circuit in the shortest possible time!^L^7

The object of this undertaking is to rescue all the miners possible before running out of lives.

^L^;To fly up: Push forward. To run or fly left or right: Move left or right. To fly down a shaft: Step off the ledge.

Press [{^BBUTTON_SELECTCHOICE^;+gostand}] to fire the Microlaser Beam. To place and ignite dynamite: press and hold down. Be sure to run away!

^L^;You will be controlling the player on your team who is holding the hockey stick. This will always be the player closest to the puck. Moving your joystick left moves your player left, and moving it right moves him right. Push forward or pull back to move up and down the ice.

To take a shot, ^L^;Press [{^BBUTTON_SELECTCHOICE^;+gostand}]. You can control the angle of your shot depending on where the puck is on your stick when you fire. ^7

Only you can stop him.

^L^;Catch as many bombs as you can with your buckets of water. If a bomb gets past you and explodes, you'll lose one of your buckets!^L^7
hash_5d25f23c7dedbdeb:
Catch the krook, recover the loot and be careful to boot! Don't get KO'd by wild shopping carts, beachballs or biplanes. 

^;Jump when you push [{^BBUTTON_SELECTCHOICE^;+gostand}]. For a long, running jump, press the red button while pushing your Joystick left or right. Duck down when you pull the Joystick down. Any of the following will cause you to lose a Kop:
- Colliding with a biplane.
- Running out of time.
- Allowing a Krook to escape off the roof.^7

Hint: DON'T GET STUCK ON THE ROOF!! Because you can't get back down! Stay behind the Krook and don't go to the roof until he's up there.

Back for more! Pitfall Harry has descended into a mysterious cavern beneath Machu Pichu, Peru in search of the cursed Raj diamond. Unfortunately he lost his niece Rhonda, along with their cowardly cat, Quickclaw.

^L^;You start each adventure with 4000 points. Some misfortunes will deduct points. Each treasure you find will add points to your score.

You'll have unlimited time to find Rhonda, Quickclaw, and the Raj diamond, or to achieve a perfect score of 199,000! To achieve the perfect score, you'll also need to find 28 missing gold bars and an ancient cave rat, all without losing any points! Adventure calls again!^L^7

hash_396f64dd3410aad3:
Flash!  Across America, awful jawfuls of junk food are causing deadly dental decay. Blast this junk with toothpaste before it gets to your teeth! This is the Plaque Attack, by cuspid, the last stop before gum city!

^;Press down and you'll aim toward the lower mouth.  Press up and you'll aim toward the upper mouth. Press [{^BBUTTON_SELECTCHOICE^;+gostand}] to squirt the toothpaste. As soon as you start, you'll have 35 seconds to wipe out each wave of food.  Your tube will shrink as time runs out.^7

You begin with eight teeth in your mouth.  With each increase of 2000 points, a bonus tooth will appear beneath your score.  

When things get tough, don't go after food particles that are not moving towards your teeth.  If they're moving off to the side, let them go, concentrating only on defending your teeth from food heading their  way.  Play defensively when the going gets tough but, in the early stages, it's best to play offensively, blasting away all the junk food in sight.^7

Your divers have retrieved the buried treasure, and now you must come to their rescue.  The object of Seaquest is to retrieve as many treasure-divers as you can, while dodging and blasting enemy subs and killer sharks.  All before your oxygen runs out!

^L^;Press [{^BBUTTON_SELECTCHOICE^;+gostand}] to fire torpedoes, hold it down for continuous fire.  Pull the Joystick back and you'll submerge; push it forward and you will ascend.  Move the Joystick left or right to face your sub to the left or to the right.  Push the Joystick to the left or right to move your sub in that direction

hash_25708225710b319:
Now you can ski all year long without worrying about tight boots, cold hands, long lift lines - or whether it snows! Skiing challenges you with a wide variety of slalom and downhill runs, designed for everyone from amateur to pro.

^L^;Tap a direction to start a run. There are 5 Slalom runs and 5 Downhill runs. In Slalom, go between all gates as fast as possible. In Downhill, reach the bottom of the hill with the fastest time..^7 

Hint: Keep your skis pointed as straight down the hill as possible.  The less you traverse across the slope, the faster you'll make it to the bottom. When you want to maneuver, tap lightly to the right or left rather than push heavily on the stick.
hash_41031499d55a0381:
The object of the game is to protect your fruit orchard from insect fruit thieves, scoring points by exterminating the attackers.

^;Action begins when the first Master Nest descends. Press [{^BBUTTON_SELECTCHOICE^;+gostand}] to fire. A good strategy is to first gun down the lone Spy Pod.  If you can exterminate that Pod, you halt the flow of reinforcements.  Afterwards, you can pick off the rest of the attackers, leaving the Master Nest for last.^7

Sometimes a Master Nest will release a continuous stream of Spy Pods, and each one you hit seems to be replaced.  If this happens, try to immediately destroy the Master Nest.  Normally, it is best to destroy the slower Spy Pods and Green Widows that hover near the bottom of the screen before killing the Master Nest.  A low-flying Stinger is your worst enemy.
